descriptionChirho: Qal active sense: to trample or tread upon something, typically enemies or peoples, expressing decisive victory or domination (Isa 14:25; 63:6; Ps 44:6; 60:14; 108:14; Ezek 16:6)
Piel intensive sense: to trample down thoroughly, emphasizing completeness or severity of the destruction (Jer 12:10; Isa 63:18)
Hitpael reflexive sense: to roll oneself, wallow (in blood), describing a reflexive bodily action rather than an act against another (Ezek 16:6; 16:22)
Hofal passive sense: to be trampled upon, the passive counterpart of the Qal, describing the state of being trodden down (Isa 14:19)
